description: This file defines the Java class `PollControlClusterEvent` which extends `ClusterCommandEvent`. It appears to represent a specific event related to the Poll Control Cluster in a mock Zigbee core simulation, encapsulating command identification and cluster details.

classes.name: PollControlClusterEvent
classes.description: Represents an event for the Poll Control Cluster in Zigbee device simulation, extending ClusterCommandEvent and encapsulating command ID and cluster details.

methods.name: PollControlClusterEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with details from the MockPollControlCluster instance, including EUI64, endpoint ID, cluster ID, and server flag, along with a fixed command ID.
